title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Classifier Chains
abstract: arXiv:2611.32118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-label classification continues to be relevant to a variety of modern tasks. Among other challenges, modern data sets are increasingly large with respect to the number of labels, and these labels may be noisy or missing in the training sets. Label-wise scores and ranking-based metrics have been popular, but optimising exact multi-label evaluation (where a predicted set of labels should match the true set exactly) is particularly relevant for many domains, e.g., in medicine; alongside some measure of confidence. This requires an estimation of joint probability across labels (a model of label dependence; conditioned on each input instance). A family of methods known as probabilistic classifier chains provides such inference. However, these existing varieties either do not scale to a large number of labels or do so by approximating joint via marginal distributions in a way that compromises the estimation of uncertainty for exact match

translated_title: 用于分类器链的蒙特卡洛树搜索
translated_abstract: 多标签分类在众多现代任务中仍然十分重要。在诸多挑战中，现代数据集的标签数量日益庞大，且这些标签在训练集中可能存在噪声或缺失。基于标签的评分和基于排序的指标一直很流行，但优化精确的多标签评估（即预测的标签集合应与真实集合完全匹配）对许多领域（如医学）尤为重要，同时还需提供某种置信度度量。这需要对标签之间的联合概率进行估计（即标签依赖性模型，以每个输入实例为条件）。被称为概率分类器链的一系列方法提供了这样的推断能力。然而，现有的这些方法要么无法扩展到大量标签的场景，要么通过边缘分布来近似联合分布以实现扩展，但这种近似方式会损害对精确匹配不确定性的估计。
tldr: 本文提出将蒙特卡洛树搜索应用于分类器链，使概率分类器链能够扩展到大量标签的多标签分类任务，同时保持对精确匹配预测不确定性的准确估计。
en_tdlr: This paper applies Monte Carlo Tree Search to classifier chains, enabling probabilistic classifier chains to scale to large numbers of labels while preserving accurate uncertainty estimation for exact match prediction.
